# `tfctl api` reference

Perform direct API operations with HCP Terraform.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl api <subcommand> [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl api` command provides subcommands for performing direct API operations with HCP Terraform. Use these commands to create resources and retrieve data using the HCP Terraform API.

## Subcommands

- [`create`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/api/create) - Create API resources
- [`get`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/api/get) - Get API resources

## Examples

The following command retrieves workspace details:

```shell-session
$ tfctl api get workspaces/ws-abc123
```

The following command creates a new workspace:

```shell-session
$ tfctl api create workspaces --data '{"data":{"type":"workspaces","attributes":{"name":"new-workspace"}}}'
```

## Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.
